Political Violence and Terrorism Insurance

Political unrest and terrorism are unpredictable—but their impact on your business is not. From property damage to operational shutdowns, the financial consequences of political violence can be severe. This is why forward-thinking companies invest in Political Violence & Terrorism Insurance.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Political Violence & Terrorism Insurance that covers the following:
• Losses due to terrorism, sabotage, strikes, riots, civil commotion, malicious damage, insurrection, revolution and rebellion, mutiny, counter insurgency, coup d’etat, war and civil war
• Terrorism liability for third party property damage and bodily injury
• Business interruption
• Contingent business interruption, denial of access, and forced abandonment

What is the information needed for Political Violence and Terrorism Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Location of Property
• Type of Property - residential, industrial, or commercial

• Properties to be Insured
o Building
o Contents
o Machineries and equipment
o Stocks
o Valuable items/works of art

• Mortgage, if applicable
• Loss history
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity

Valuation of Property:
• Replacement Value - amount if a similar property will be built NOW
• Sound Value - replacement value less the accrued depreciation
• Fair Market Value - value of a similar property in the market
